component.name: ruum
component.summary: Interactive treemap disk space analyzer and cleanup tool

description.p: ruum turns local drives and remote SSH volumes into an interactive nested treemap sized by actual allocated disk usage, keeping your volume's live free space in view while you explore and reclaim space.
Mark directories and files non-destructively, review the reclaimable list with safety guards, and remove targets to the system trash or permanently with full before-and-after verification.
